claims.claim_text: An isolated cyclic polypeptide consisting of an amino acid sequence selected from the group consisting of SEQ ID NO: 177, SEQ ID NO: 178 and SEQ ID NO: 179, wherein said isolated cyclic polypeptide inhibits binding of IL-23 to IL-23 receptor and inhibits IL-23-mediated cell signaling.
The isolated cyclic polypeptide of claim 1, wherein said isolated cyclic polypeptide consisting of SEQ ID NO: 177.
The isolated cyclic polypeptide of claim 1, wherein said isolated cyclic polypeptide consisting of SEQ ID NO: 178.
The isolated cyclic polypeptide of claim 1, wherein said isolated cyclic polypeptide consisting of SEQ ID NO: 179.

A method of inhibiting production of IL-17F in a Th17 cell in a human, comprising the steps of: a) providing a human Th17 cell in need of inhibiting production of IL-17F; and b) exposing said Th17 cell to said isolated cyclic polypeptide of claim 1.
The method of claim 5, wherein said IL-17F is IL-17F protein.
The method of claim 5, wherein said production of IL-17F is assayed by an ELISA.

A method of inhibiting production of IL-17F in a splenocyte in a human, comprising the steps of: a) providing a human splenocyte in need of inhibiting production of IL-17F from said splenocyte; and b) exposing said splenocyte to said isolated cyclic polypeptide of claim 1.
The method of claim 8, wherein said IL-17F is IL-17F mRNA.
The method of claim 8, wherein said production of IL-17F is assayed by RT-PCR.

A method of inhibiting production of IL-22 from a mononuclear cell in a human, comprising the steps of: a) providing a human mononuclear cell in need of inhibiting production of IL-22 from said mononuclear cell; and b) exposing said mononuclear cell to said isolated cyclic polypeptide of claim 1.
The method of claim 11, wherein said IL-22 is IL-22 protein.
The method of claim 11, wherein said production of IL-22 is assayed by an ELISA.
